continuity.handoff.briefCutTwice: The handoff instruction arrived cut short twice; have the new CLI read {path} yourself
continuity.handoff.briefNeverArrived: The handoff instruction never showed up in the new CLI's transcript; have it read {path} yourself
continuity.handoff.conversationChanged: This tmux moved to another conversation before the handoff
continuity.handoff.exitedBeforeTakeover: The CLI taking over exited before it took over
continuity.handoff.exitedInFirstTurn: The CLI taking over exited before its first turn ended
continuity.handoff.exitedMarkedDone: The CLI taking over exited without taking over (it was recorded as done)
continuity.handoff.neverStarted: The new CLI never finished starting
continuity.handoff.notReadyForBrief: The new CLI wasn't ready to take the handoff; sort it out, then have it read {path} yourself
continuity.handoff.otherCliRunning: Another CLI is already running in this tmux, so it wasn't restarted
continuity.handoff.relaunchedAfterUpdate: {label}: the CLI exited after updating itself; started again
continuity.handoff.stillReplying: The CLI taking over is still replying; wait for its report
continuity.handoff.switchFailed: Switching to the new CLI didn't work
continuity.handoff.turnNeverEnded: The current turn never ended, so it couldn't switch: {reason}
continuity.handoff.unknownScreen: The CLI stopped at a screen the app doesn't recognize; the handoff hasn't been sent
continuity.handoff.updatePromptUnsure: The CLI is asking whether to update, and the option couldn't be found
continuity.handoff.updateSkippedStill: The CLI is asking whether to update; "Skip" was chosen but the prompt is still there
continuity.push.earlierFailed: The earlier handoff to {label} didn't work: {reason}. You can restart it and hand off again
continuity.push.earlierRelaunched: The earlier handoff to {label} didn't work (the CLI exited after updating itself); restarted it in the same session and handed off again
continuity.push.limitCliResumes: Usage limit reached; the CLI will continue on its own at {time}
continuity.push.limitDailyCap: Usage limit reached; it has already continued automatically {count} times in 24 hours, so not this time
continuity.push.limitHandoff: Usage limit reached; handing off to {label}
continuity.push.limitNoResetTime: Usage limit reached, but the reset time couldn't be read; it won't continue automatically
continuity.push.limitScheduled: Usage limit reached; it will continue automatically at {time}
continuity.push.lowHandoff: {remaining}% of usage left; handing off to {label}
continuity.push.lowNoTarget: {remaining}% of usage left, but no other account in the chain can take over; staying on this account
continuity.push.nextTarget: {label} didn't take over ({reason}); handing off to {next} instead
continuity.push.outHandoff: Usage is used up; handing off to {label}
continuity.push.relaunchedAfterUpdate: {label} exited after updating itself; started it again in the same session
continuity.push.reported: {label} read the handoff brief and reported back
continuity.push.resetCliDidNotResume: Usage has reset, but the CLI didn't continue on its own (Esc may have been pressed in the terminal)
continuity.push.resetCliGone: Usage has reset, but the CLI is no longer running; it wasn't continued
continuity.push.resetDailyCap: Usage has reset, but today's automatic continues are used up; it wasn't continued
continuity.push.resetPromptWaiting: Usage has reset, but the CLI is waiting for your answer; it wasn't continued
continuity.push.resumeFailed: Usage has reset, but continuing automatically failed: {reason}
continuity.push.switchWaitsForTurn: Switching to {label} waits for the current turn to end: {reason}
continuity.push.tookOver: Handed off to {label}; it has taken over
continuity.push.unknownScreen: {label} stopped at a screen the app doesn't recognize; the handoff hasn't been sent
continuity.push.updatePromptUnsure: {label} is asking whether to update and the option couldn't be found; choose "Skip" in the terminal
continuity.push.updateSkippedStill: {label} is asking whether to update; "Skip" was chosen but the prompt is still there
